'''2001 North American Continental Championship''' was the Star Wars CCG North American Continental Championship, held at Gen Con in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Day 1 was Friday 3 August and Day 2 was Saturday 4 August 2001.<ref name="tr-snider1">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-geoff-goes-to-continentalsd2789/ geoff-goes-to-continentals], Geoff "gsiva" Snider, DeckTech (6 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-geoff-goes-to-continentalsd2789/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-snider">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-geoff-goes-to-gen-con-part-2d2791/ geoff-goes-to-gen-con-part-2], Geoff "gsiva" Snider, DeckTech (6 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-geoff-goes-to-gen-con-part-2d2791/ GitHub Pages].</ref> [[Jonny Chu]] beat [[Scott Diehl]] in the final, winning both games.<ref name="tr-kohman">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-kohman-does-gen-con-and-likes-itd2792/ kohman-does-gen-con-and-likes-it], Josh-e-poo "supaposhjosh" Kohman, DeckTech (6 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-06-kohman-does-gen-con-and-likes-itd2792/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="tr-snider" />

* '''Dates:''' 3–4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Gen Con, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]

Geoff Snider wrote that he took "7th??? (maybe 8th???)". He played an ISB/Scum Dark deck and a Light deck he said he did not design ("not my deck, but this is what i played").<ref name="tr-snider" /><ref name="dt-18108" />

The 4th and 5th place players, Corey and Justin of a Wisconsin team, both played the Light racing list that [[Damian Loback]] later posted. Loback wrote that the deck was 24–1 in tournament play.<ref name="dt-19342" />
